title: The plus construction computes sheafification
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be a site [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology] and let $\mathcal F$ be a presheaf of sets on $\mathcal C$. Let $\mathcal F^+$ be its plus construction and $\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^+$ the canonical map [def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction]: $\mathcal F^+(U)=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal J_U^{opp}}H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$, the colimit over the coverings $\mathcal U$ of $U$ and their refinements of the sets $H^0(\mathcal U,\mathcal F)$ of families $(s_i)\in\prod_i\mathcal F(U_i)$ with $s_i|_{U_i\times_UU_j}=s_j|_{U_i\times_UU_j}$; it is a presheaf and $\theta_{\mathcal F}$ a morphism of presheaves [lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf]. Put $\mathcal F^{++}=(\mathcal F^+)^+$ and $\theta^2_{\mathcal F}=\theta_{\mathcal F^+}\circ\theta_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^{++}$. Then (Stacks Sites, Theorem 00WB and Proposition 00WH): (1) $\mathcal F^+$ is separated and the canonical map $\theta_{\mathcal F^+}:\mathcal F^+\to\mathcal F^{++}$ is injective, as in [lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-plus-separated]; (2) $\mathcal F^{++}$ is a sheaf; (3) $\theta^2_{\mathcal F}:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^{++}$ is a sheafification: for every sheaf of sets $\mathcal G$ on $\mathcal C$ and every morphism of presheaves $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ there is a unique morphism $\varphi':\mathcal F^{++}\to\mathcal G$ with $\varphi'\circ\theta^2_{\mathcal F}=\varphi$. Consequently, if $\theta:\mathcal F\to\mathcal F^\#$ is the universal-property sheafification [def-weil-pbc-sheafification], there is a unique isomorphism $\mathcal F^{++}\simeq\mathcal F^\#$ of presheaves carrying $\theta^2_{\mathcal F}$ to $\theta$.

split_report.summary: Checked against Stacks Sites Section 00W1 (Theorem 00WB, Definition 00WG, Proposition 00WH; tags checked in tags/tags). The statement defined F^+ ad hoc as classes of families whose pullbacks agree only after a further covering of U_i x_U U_j, which is not Stacks's H^0 condition (exact agreement on U_i x_U U_j); it now uses the plus construction node def-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction (colimit over J_U) created by the split of lem-weil-pbc-sheafification-plus-separated, cites lem-weil-pbc-site-plus-construction-presheaf for F^+ being a presheaf, makes the canonical map theta^2 explicit and states the universal property of clause (3) (Stacks Prop. 00WH, not part of 00WB). Proof in five steps: (1) by the separated node; (2) by the new node 'G separated => G^+ sheaf' (00WB(2)); (3) existence via functoriality (new node, Lemma 00W5) and 'G sheaf => G -> G^+ iso' (new node, 00WB(3)); (4) uniqueness via local surjectivity (parts (1),(3) of the presheaf node, i.e. Lemma 00W9) and separatedness of sheaves; (5) unique iso with F^# by universal properties (elementary). Mathlib has all of this for plusObj over covering sieves (Plus.lean, ConcreteSheafification.lean, LeftExact.lean), recorded as candidates, not leaves, since the family/sieve identification is a theorem.

lean.statement: theorem plus_sheafification_theorem {C : Type u} [SmallCategory C] (J : Precoverage C) [J.HasIsos] [J.IsStableUnderComposition] [J.IsStableUnderBaseChange] [J.HasPullbacks] (P : Cᵒᵖ ⥤ Type (max u w)) : (∀ (U : C) (E : Precoverage.ZeroHypercover.{max u w} J U) (s s' : (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).obj (op U)), (∀ i : E.I₀, (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.f i).op s = (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P).map (E.f i).op s') → s = s') ∧ (∀ U : C, Function.Injective ((J.toGrothendieck.toPlus (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)).app (op U))) ∧ Presheaf.IsSheaf J.toGrothendieck (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)) ∧ (∀ (G : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u w))) (φ : P ⟶ G.obj), ∃! φ' : J.toGrothendieck.plusObj (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P) ⟶ G.obj, (J.toGrothendieck.toPlus P ≫ J.toGrothendieck.toPlus (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)) ≫ φ' = φ) ∧ (∀ (Q : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u w))) (θ : P ⟶ Q.obj), (∀ (G : Sheaf J.toGrothendieck (Type (max u w))) (φ : P ⟶ G.obj), ∃! ψ : Q.obj ⟶ G.obj, θ ≫ ψ = φ) → ∃! e : J.toGrothendieck.plusObj (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P) ≅ Q.obj, (J.toGrothendieck.toPlus P ≫ J.toGrothendieck.toPlus (J.toGrothendieck.plusObj P)) ≫ e.hom = θ)
lean.note: Uses the dependency records plusObj/toPlus on the generated topology. Includes separatedness on covering families, objectwise injectivity, the double-plus sheaf property, unique factorization, and the unique comparison isomorphism with every universal-property sheafification.
